kurz: Cook gently in hot but not boiling water. Classic for eggs and fish.
bild_im_kopf: Like dozing off in a warm bath rather than a jacuzzi.
was_passiert: Below boiling point, the protein sets evenly without shredding. A splash of vinegar makes the white set faster; fresh eggs hold together better.
schritte: Bring water to a simmer, with only single bubbles.
Crack the egg into a cup and slide it gently into the water.
Lift it out with a slotted spoon and drain.
